description: This file contains test cases for the Playwright selectors registration feature, verifying atomicity and behavior of custom selectors like textContent, innerText, innerHTML, getAttribute, and isVisible within the Playwright testing framework.

methods.name: textContent should be atomic
methods.description: Tests that the 'textContent' selector returns correct value and modifications to DOM are atomic when using a custom dummy selector.

methods.name: innerText should be atomic
methods.description: Verifies that the 'innerText' selector behaves atomically with a custom dummy selector.

methods.name: innerHTML should be atomic
methods.description: Checks that the 'innerHTML' selector correctly reflects changes and operates atomically.

methods.name: getAttribute should be atomic
methods.description: Ensures that the 'getAttribute' selector retrieves attribute values atomically when manipulated via custom selector.

methods.name: isVisible should be atomic
methods.description: Verifies atomicity of the 'isVisible' selector by modifying style and checking visibility.

methods.name: should take java-style string
methods.description: Tests that the selectors registration accepts string literals following a JavaScript object literal pattern.
